fusions.name: Numbing Pellet
fusions.desc: Fires a chilled pellet that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Long Bask
fusions.desc: Fires a single shot that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood
fusions.desc: Removes 2 conditions from you, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Daylight Marksman
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 10% more damage.
